# glpi_rack (Data Source)

Look up a GLPI rack.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_rack" "by_name" {
  name = "example"
}

data "glpi_rack" "by_id" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Name of the item. Set id or name; must match exactly one item.

### Read-Only

- `background_color` (String) Background color of the rack in the room view, such as #d9ead3.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `datacenter_room_id` (Number) ID of the data center room that holds the rack.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `location_id` (Number) ID of the location.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) ID of the manufacturer.
- `max_power` (Number) Maximum power in watts.
- `model_id` (Number) ID of the rack model.
- `otherserial` (String) Inventory number.
- `position` (String) Position of the rack in the room grid, written as "column,row".
- `room_orientation` (Number) Orientation of the rack in the room.
- `serial` (String) Serial number.
- `state_id` (Number) ID of the status.
- `type_id` (Number) ID of the rack type.
- `units` (Number) Number of rack units.
